Good places to start

Procedures that map cleanly onto a first agent.

  • +1↗ KYC onboarding reviewCheck documents, screen the applicant and apply your risk rules, with a reviewer where the procedure asks.
  • +1↗ Sanctions screeningScreen counterparties before the first payment and send each possible match to a person.
  • +1↗ Periodic KYC reviewFind the reviews that are due by risk rating, refresh the file and route changes to a reviewer.
  • +1↗ Chargebacks and disputesGather the cardholder's claim and the transaction data, map it to your scheme rules and queue the proposal for an analyst.
  • +1↗ Credit file checkCompare the application with the credit file, apply your flags and route differences to an underwriter.

AML & compliance

Onboarding, screening and monitoring work that follows your procedures.

  • +1↗ KYC onboarding reviewCheck documents, screen the applicant and apply your risk rules, with a reviewer where the procedure asks.
  • +1↗ KYB and beneficial ownershipMap owners and controllers above your threshold, screen each one and flag gaps for a reviewer.
  • +1↗ Sanctions screeningScreen counterparties before the first payment and send each possible match to a person.
  • +1↗ PEP and adverse media reviewCompare each PEP or adverse media hit with the customer file and put the evidence in front of a reviewer.
  • +1↗ Periodic KYC reviewFind the reviews that are due by risk rating, refresh the file and route changes to a reviewer.
  • +1↗ Transaction monitoring alert triageGather the alert, customer profile and history, apply your disposition rules and route what needs a person.
  • +1↗ Fraud alert triageCollect the device, account and transaction context for each fraud alert and put a decision in front of an analyst.

Cards

Disputes and limit reviews, with the evidence gathered for the reviewer.

  • +1↗ Chargebacks and disputesGather the cardholder's claim and the transaction data, map it to your scheme rules and queue the proposal for an analyst.
  • +1↗ Credit limit increase reviewRun the exposure and account checks in your policy and send anything outside it to a reviewer.

Lending & credit

File and application checks before an underwriter opens the case.

  • +1↗ Credit file checkCompare the application with the credit file, apply your flags and route differences to an underwriter.
  • +1↗ Loan application completenessCheck each application against your document and field checklist before an underwriter opens it.

Operations

Vendor checks, complaints and account closures, run from your written procedure.

  • +1↗ Vendor due diligenceCheck each new vendor's papers, screen the company and its owners and flag gaps for a person.
  • +1↗ Complaints triageCategorize each complaint on arrival, apply your response timelines and route sensitive cases to a person.
  • +1↗ Account closure reviewCheck each closure request against your list of holds, open items and alerts before anyone closes the account.
